items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I was mostly a fan of Denny Goodman's. Not Benny Goodman himself but the band playing Fletcher Henderson's arrangements.

ctx.x: Benny Goodman for instance, what did you do for him, do you remember?
